title: AsyncAPI v3 - OAuth2 Password flow (Resource Owner Password Credentials Flow)
description: Contains information about OAuth2 Implicit flow. Allows a client application to exchange a user's direct username and password for an access token. However, modern security standards strongly advise against using it because it exposes raw credentials and blocks multi-factor authentication

scopes.description: The available scopes for the OAuth2 security scheme. A map between the scope name and a short description for it

refreshUrl.description: The URL to be used for obtaining refresh tokens. This MUST be in the form of an absolute URL

tokenUrl.description: The token URL to be used for this flow. This MUST be in the form of an absolute URL
